title: Port of CAW
meta_description: Port of CAW: 3BR, 3BA luxury Gulf-front home in Dune Allen Beach, with 2 Gulf-front porches, a beach boardwalk, and a full kitchen. Sleeps 6.
description_expanded: Description: Port of CAW by Royal Destinations Location: Dune Allen Beach Address: 89 Seaward Drive Details: Port of CAW is a welcoming Gulf-front home located within the gated Sunrise Beach community near Gulf Place. Offering 3,168 square feet of indoor and outdoor living space, this coastal retreat comfortably accommodates up to 6 guests with three bedrooms and three full baths. Expansive Gulf views, two Gulf-front covered porches, and a private boardwalk leading directly to the beach create an ideal setting for enjoying the beauty of 30A from morning to sunset. Inside, the main living level features an open gathering space with a fully equipped kitchen, dining accommodations, and doors opening to the Gulf-front porch. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms offer Gulf-front accommodations and direct porch access, including a spacious King master suite with a sitting area and beautifully appointed private bath. Guests are also within walking distance of Gulf Place, where local restaurants, shops, and galleries provide plenty to explore. Daily beach service is included, making it easy to spend your days enjoying the sugar-white sand and emerald waters just beyond the home. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front with Private Beach Boardwalk -Parking Spaces: (2) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 6, Island Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Daily Beach Service Included* -Gated Community -(2) Gulf-Front Covered Porches -Expansive Gulf Views -Outdoor Gas Grill -Outdoor Shower -Walking Distance to Gulf Place *Daily beach service includes (4) chairs and (2) umbrellas. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 6 3 Bedrooms / 3 Baths Second Floor: -Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with Detached Full Bath (Tub/Shower) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Gulf-Front Covered Porch Third Floor: -Bedroom 2: (2) Double Beds with Private Bath (Tub/Shower), Gulf Views and Gulf-Front Porch Access -Bedroom 3 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub, Walk-In Shower, Separate Vanities, Water Closet), Sitting Area, Gulf Views and Gulf-Front Porch Access -Laundry Area -Gulf-Front Covered Porch Please Note: *Parking is limited to a maximum of (2) vehicles in the driveway. The garage is not accessible to guests, and on-street parking is prohibited within the Sunrise Beach community. *LSVs are permitted but must be parked in the driveway and count as one vehicle toward the two-vehicle parking maximum. *The fireplaces in the living room and master bedroom are decorative only and are not available for guest use. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
